ex.en: Mary got the nod from among some 500 applicants.
ex.zh: 瑪麗從大約 500 名應徵者中脫穎而出。

ex.en: Does the applicant have suitable abilities to carry out the job?
ex.zh: 這位應徵者有能力勝任這份工作嗎？

ex.en: The position requires applicants to be skilled in spoken English.
ex.zh: 這個職位要求應徵者具備良好的英語口說能力。

ex.en: I have my annual appraisal next week.
ex.zh: 我下週有年度考核。

ex.en: The appraisal showed that she needs more training.
ex.zh: 考核結果顯示她需要更多訓練。

ex.en: We need an appraisal of the house before selling it.
ex.zh: 賣房子前我們需要先估價。

ex.en: The jeweler gave us an appraisal of the ring.
ex.zh: 珠寶商幫我們鑑定了這枚戒指的價值。

ex.en: I am waiting for approval.
ex.zh: 我在等核准。

ex.en: He gave me his stamp of approval.
ex.zh: 他正式批准了我。

ex.en: The plan needs approval from the board.
ex.zh: 這個計畫需要董事會核准。

ex.en: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
ex.zh: 如果您同意，我想把這份工作給他。

ex.en: Tom nodded approval.
ex.zh: 湯姆點頭表示贊同。

ex.en: Approximately thirty young people attended.
ex.zh: 約有三十個年輕人到了。

ex.en: Tom fell approximately 30 meters.
ex.zh: 湯姆摔落了大約 30 公尺。

ex.en: Sami called at approximately six.
ex.zh: 薩米大約六點打來。

ex.en: The boss has already approved of our plans.
ex.zh: 老闆已經批准了我們的計劃。

ex.en: That four-year plan has to be approved.
ex.zh: 那個四年計畫必須經過核准。

ex.en: The manager approved our plan.
ex.zh: 經理批准了我們的計劃。

ex.en: Do you approve of what he is doing?
ex.zh: 你贊成他正在做的事嗎？

ex.en: That's why I don't approve of your plan.
ex.zh: 這就是我不贊成你計畫的原因。

ex.en: Tom is thinking about applying for a better-paying job.
ex.zh: 湯姆正在考慮應徵一份薪水更好的工作。

ex.en: I haven't decided which job to apply for.
ex.zh: 我還沒決定要應徵哪份工作。

ex.en: When applying to American universities, your TOEFL score is only one factor.
ex.zh: 申請美國大學時，托福成績只是其中一項考量。

ex.en: This kind of medicine can only be applied externally.
ex.zh: 這種藥物只能外用。

ex.en: Apply sunscreen before you go outside.
ex.zh: 出門前先擦防曬乳。

ex.en: This still applies to him.
ex.zh: 這點對他仍然適用。

ex.en: These rules apply to all visitors.
ex.zh: 這些規定適用於所有訪客。

ex.en: The due date for submitting the application is this Friday.
ex.zh: 申請截止日是這個星期五。

ex.en: We've received a lot of applications in answer to our advertisements.
ex.zh: 我們的徵人廣告已經收到很多應徵申請。

ex.en: Tom filled out the job application form.
ex.zh: 湯姆填好了求職申請表。

ex.en: The cellphone came with several applications already pre-installed.
ex.zh: 這支手機出廠時就預先安裝了幾個應用程式。

ex.en: This application lets you track your expenses.
ex.zh: 這個應用程式可以記錄你的花費。

ex.en: He has a remarkable aptitude for music.
ex.zh: 他有非凡的音樂天分。

ex.en: She shows a natural aptitude for languages.
ex.zh: 她很有語言天分。
